<p dir="auto"><strong>ConsensusBasedXPlots.jl</strong> is an auxiliary package to visualise the output of <a href="https://PdIPS.github.io/ConsensusBasedX.jl/" rel="nofollow">ConsensusBasedX.jl</a>.
